build_sampler_loop: build a SamplerLoop instance with a transformer model, end tokens, forbidden tokens, and sampling method for autoregressive generation
run_sample_autoregressive: run the SamplerLoop sample method with params and SamplingState to generate tokens autoregressively up to max_new_tokens
run_stream_sample: run the SamplerLoop sample method with stream true to yield SamplingState after each token prediction step
review_sampling_state: review the SamplingState dataclass attributes including step, done, last_token, predicted_tokens, cache, and attention mask
refactor_mask_tokens_after_end: refactor the mask tokens after end tokens function to zero out token IDs following EOS tokens in the output buffer
